item.title: Linux Remote Desktop on Vr
item.description:
Scope

My main laptop has a dual boot Linux/Windows setup with a Quest 3. I want a simple screen mirror solution. It would be a bonus to have a full remote desktop experience with client keyboard and mouse input, but the main usecase is just screen mirroring.

I use Ubuntu 24.04 LTS with mostly stock settings. I don’t want VNC or RDP because of audio latency video lag.

We will use Steam Link from the Meta Store. It is the most seemless way to get the features while maintaining official app support.

item.description:
Mimeyoi

https://mimeyoi.co/

https://sophie.studio/

Notes: They are a anime figure producer.

Pros:

  • Image as big as possible
  • Mouse-mased navigation with large buttons

Cons:

  • Breaks in mobile splitscreen

Valorant

https://cmsassets.rgpub.io/sanity/images/dsfx7636/news_live/e1085d08cd5c01a98401a2a04e7477d8f27d0689-1920x1080.jpg

The website does show the art style I’m looking for. I like how there is this cyberpunk vibe and the backgrounds look very 2d while being hypebeast.

Bontanist

https://botanistofficial.com/product/item/

A shampoo company

Notes:

  • Again, most people want a bold first impression with text, the product, and a high definition picture. Sometimes with animation.

item.title: About Me
item.description:
VRChat Profile

Heyo, BlankVersa here. I am a(n aspiring) content creator. I make media such as music, 3D models, art, and media reviews. I really like the Jirai Kei asthetic which is a mix between gothic and cutesy vibe (and this is what the website style is based on).

I made this site to showcase what programming I can do and what things I can create. Specifically, I wanted a place where people on the internet can see all of my work and get to know me more (cuz I’m not much of a talker).
